propositions: Ordinal severity labels (low/medium/high) on undecomposed and dod_uncertifiable axes are unreliable for deterministic LLM gate behavior and map to identical decision floor (0.85) regardless of grade, making the distinction inert.

Both axes must convert to closed Literal kind sets mapping six distinct defect categories deterministically to either advisory (contribution 0.55, no floor) or gap/flooring (contribution 1.0, floor 0.85) outcomes.

The inert G5-suppressor hedge (veto_undecomposed_g5) never fired, the prompts and _SEV01 mapping must be deleted, and impact_plan must read both axes through new *_GRADE01 maps in three places (MAX, floor loop, amplifier force).

A zero-LLM re-score of 22,667 recorded findings against a pinned plan-v4 baseline shows 15–47 lost blocks in the pessimistic bound, all audited as advisory or specificity findings with no unjustified loss on genuine-gap outcomes.
The conversion lands atomically under one IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump (plan-v4 → plan-v5) batching the prompt rewrite, both kind-set conversions, and decision-margin telemetry per ADR 0054 section 4.
